title: Fashion, money and the family's collapse
summary: Earning $300-400 a week, fine clothes, then father's bankruptcy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Beautiful little blonde. And she was about 16 years old. She used to like me a lot. An old man found out about it. And he put a stout to it. Yeah. I couldn't stand for that. No. But boy she could dress. And I used to dress at the time myself. I was one of the best dressed in the city. I mean for amateur musicians at the time. And you know. And that. See Alna Riega was also a real good dresser. They used to have around eight tailor made suits, about 75 Irish shirts with other accessories, and about three or four silk shirts. And then over 100 times, every week, I mean I sort of go to Rubenstein and sit with someone on the other side, on that street then. And every week I sort of get me with necktie and a shirt to match and socks, and that was it. And the old man was sitting, what, another shirt to tie? What you want to do? You made enough money selling ice cream. Oh, you used to make around three or four hundred dollars a week at the time. I thought it was going to last forever.
Well that's a lot of money. Everything went bad then, I mean.
The old man went bankrupt and so forth. In the meantime, I got married and had a gang of children and that was it.
